entries.reason: Registered supporting document for package context and provenance. Registration does not establish measurement coverage or expand source permissions; route any relevant content outside the review assignment.
Registered proposal supplies project definitions and restrictions. Access is limited to supplied extracted text; planned analyses and resource descriptions are not observed data or verified coverage.
Permitted S21 IP plasma input candidate. Review dose basis, censoring and sampling identity; column labels do not establish longitudinal animals or links to efficacy panels.

Permitted S21 SC ELF input candidate, separate from IP plasma. Review urea correction, missing numeric LLOQ, sample-count discrepancy and unverified cross-time identity without inferring a pulmonary bridge.
Permitted terminal P. aeruginosa lung-response evidence for context and relationship review. Matched measured PK is not supplied; this pathogen cannot set K. pneumoniae targets.
Permitted terminal A. baumannii lung-response evidence for context and relationship review. Matched measured PK is not supplied; this pathogen cannot set K. pneumoniae targets.
Permitted K. pneumoniae terminal lung endpoints with reported MIC and IP regimen. Candidate target-input relevance is conditional on verified exposure linkage; no matched measured PK is supplied.
Permitted terminal P. aeruginosa lung-response evidence with an SC regimen. No matched measured PK is supplied; retain route and strain identity and do not use it to set K. pneumoniae targets.
Permitted terminal A. baumannii lung-response evidence with an SC regimen. No matched measured PK is supplied; retain route and strain identity and do not use it to set K. pneumoniae targets.

Permitted K. pneumoniae terminal lung endpoints with reported MIC and SC regimen. Review potential target-input relevance without inventing exposure links or treating terminal animals as serial profiles.
Permitted study-specific susceptibility input. Verify exact strain-to-response associations; E. coli 107 and 71 are not established aliases, and surveillance MICs cannot repair missing matches.
Permitted S02 strain MIC evidence. Preserve susceptibility methods and establish experiment-specific response matches before assigning MICs to exposure indices.
Permitted S01/S02 plasma-binding inputs. Preserve assay and preparation differences, percentage definitions and study-specific applicability; do not average conflicts or transfer plasma fu to ELF.
Permitted S02 fractionation schedules, including rounded per-injection doses and treatment-relative window. Curator labels do not establish numeric CFU-to-regimen links or exact unrounded doses.
Permitted S02-T3 group endpoints and experiment-specific baselines. Preserve n, SD and ND; do not substitute fractionation baselines, reconstruct animals or claim index-comparison sufficiency.
Permitted published fractionation-range evidence with a source conflict. Preserve printed ranges and intolerance statement; no inferred dose grid, rescaling or scatter-point matching is authorized.

Permitted S21 species-specific pooled-plasma binding evidence. Review bound-percentage definitions and applicability; pooled assay replicates are not independent PK animals, and use outside S21 plasma requires a justified review.
Permitted S05 IT ELF observed-marker means. Preserve terminal sampling, base-dose units, approximate digitization and assay limits; plasma fu does not establish ELF fu or K. pneumoniae applicability.
Permitted S05 IT ELF observed-marker means at a distinct dose. Preserve group-level evidence and digitization tolerance; do not infer serial animals, ELF binding or a cross-pathogen target.

Permitted S05 IT total-plasma observed means. Exclude any calculated unbound duplicate from observations; retain assay-based binding separately and do not use published model results for primary selection.
Permitted S05 IT total-plasma observed means. Preserve all observed means, including the source-flagged location; avoid calculated-unbound duplication and invented individual variability.

Permitted S05 IV total-plasma observed means. Keep route separate, retain the source-flagged observed location, and do not create pseudo-zero IV ELF records or use fitted source results for selection.

Mixed observed responses and published PK-simulated exposure coordinates. R11 reserves model-derived results for final benchmarking; descriptive-use source notes do not authorize primary access. E. coli cannot set K. pneumoniae targets.

Published PK-simulated exposure coordinates trigger R11's final-benchmark restriction despite observed response markers. No primary ranking or cross-panel joins; E. coli cannot set K. pneumoniae targets.

Published PK-simulated exposure coordinates are model-derived results reserved for final benchmarking. Retain incomplete-marker and matching limitations; this E. coli panel cannot supply K. pneumoniae targets.

K. pneumoniae panel has published PK-simulated exposure coordinates, so defer its mixed body under R11. Candidate index relevance does not establish common response records, complete doses or permission for primary descriptive fitting.

K. pneumoniae panel combines observed responses with model-derived exposure coordinates reserved for final benchmarking. No primary ranking, inferred panel joins or repeated fu correction is authorized.

Published simulated fAUC/MIC coordinates make this a mixed model-derived table subject to R11. Defer body access to final benchmarking; potential target relevance does not establish matched-record eligibility.
Permitted assay and missingness context for input assessment, not additional concentration observations. Preserve study-specific ND/BLQ meanings and route any out-of-assignment evidence.
Permitted S02 SC 2 mg/kg observed-marker plasma means. Preserve calibrated times, sulfate dose basis and missing point-specific uncertainty; digitization tolerance is not biological variability.
Permitted S02 SC 4 mg/kg observed-marker plasma means. Preserve source-calibrated times and group evidence; do not infer individual trajectories, SD or exposure-response joins.

Permitted S02 SC 8 mg/kg observed-marker plasma means. Review dosing and time coverage at the reported summary level without treating another dose curve as another species or independent animal records.
Permitted S02 SC 16 mg/kg observed-marker plasma means. Preserve extraction provenance and absent point-specific n/SD; review does not qualify dose-dependent kinetics or PD transfer.
Permitted S02 SC 32 mg/kg observed-marker plasma means. Preserve reported dose basis, approximate calibrated times and summary level; no invented individual variability or matching is permitted.
Permitted S02 pretreatment group baselines. They are neither untreated 24-hour controls nor Table 3 baselines; exact cohort and animal joins remain unverified.
Permitted S05 P. aeruginosa susceptibility context. It supplies neither K. pneumoniae MICs nor verified PK sample-to-strain associations; disclose that limitation in routing.

Permitted mouse PMB B1 pooled-serum binding assays. Retain analyte, ED/UF methods, concentration dependence and assay replication; do not average conflicting sources or access separately held human columns.

Permitted MIC and regimen-context review, retaining the dose inconsistency and missing CFU values. RIF is contextual only; borrowed PMB exposure is not measured PK, and published model-derived targets remain reserved.

Permitted S21 rat IV plasma candidate with a reported one-minute administration. Preserve rat identities, censoring and linked cannula-blockage footnotes; individual and variability support still require review.

Permitted rat serum and tissue-homogenate summaries from distinct terminal groups. Preserve matrix-specific units, missing salt/base basis and LLOQ flags; lung homogenate is not ELF or serial individual PK.
Permitted rat PMB B1 pooled-serum binding assays. Preserve ED/UF distinctions, percentage scale and analyte applicability; do not average conflicting sources or access human columns held separately.

Permitted rabbit exposure-summary assessment, not concentration-time observations. Review measure definitions and uncertainty; the summarized PK regimen differs from the efficacy regimen, and any fitted/model-derived results must be segregated for final benchmarking.

Permitted rabbit K. pneumoniae pulmonary outcome summaries. Preserve SEM, distinct treatment history and unresolved strain allocation; repeated controls are not established independent cohorts and S09 PK summaries are not automatically matched.

Permitted neonatal rabbit relative-response context. Preserve surfactant formulation, pre-inoculation IT administration and four-hour endpoint; no serial PK is supplied and E. coli cannot set K. pneumoniae targets.
Permitted S09 availability and limitation record for requirements assessment. It is context rather than concentration data; its gap does not negate newer S22 candidates.
Permitted S10 study-context and availability record. Do not infer concentrations or generalize its source-specific gap to all rabbit evidence.
Permitted S11 study-context and availability record. Its evidence level must be reviewed without reconstructing concentrations or treating an older-source gap as a complete search result.
Permitted S12 study-context and availability record. Review the stated limitation within this source only; do not infer concentrations or absence of newer rabbit evidence.

Permitted S22 SC plasma observed means for exploratory input assessment. Preserve plotted times, unresolved protocol/count differences and missing binding; access does not establish component identifiability, individual variability or absolute SC clearance.

Permitted S22 IT plasma observed means for exploratory input assessment. Preserve route, plotted timing, group level and unresolved sampling discrepancies; no component-support or translation qualification follows.

Permitted S22 SC ELF observed means for exploratory coverage review. Keep ELF separate from plasma and lung, preserve sampling-count discrepancies and do not infer ELF fu or biological SD from pixel tolerance.
Permitted S22 IT ELF observed means for exploratory coverage review. Preserve route-specific evidence, group means and uncertainty gaps; pulmonary identifiability remains a later determination.

Permitted S22 SC whole-lung observed means. Preserve the figure-versus-supplement peak discrepancy and reported matrix/units; do not rescale values, substitute ELF or accept fitted Cmax as primary input.

Permitted S22 IT whole-lung observed means. Preserve matrix, route, digitization provenance and source discrepancies without assuming an ELF bridge, binding correction or identifiable pulmonary component.
Permitted rabbit assay, source-qualification and missingness context. Review as requirements evidence rather than extra observations; preserve discrepancies and nonnumeric ND/BLQ records.
Explicit translation holdout. Do not admit the body until mouse/rat/rabbit scaling is frozen; later comparison must retain dose-basis, sampling, overlap and co-treatment limitations without retuning.

Printed summaries remain within the horse holdout boundary. Release only after scaling freeze; preserve text-versus-figure discrepancies rather than using summaries for primary selection or reconciliation.

Explicit horse translation holdout until scaling freeze. Later review must retain crossover arms, protocol times, medians/ranges and IU-dose limitations; no fitting, scaling, selection or priors are permitted.

Horse serum/CSF summaries remain held out until scaling freeze. Later review must distinguish matrices and pooled medians/ranges and route CSF content outside the assigned serum translation comparison.

Mixed horse holdout summaries and author-fitted results. Scaling freeze is required for observed-summary comparison; fitted half-life/clearance remain reserved for final benchmarking. Preserve assay and repeat-dose timing discrepancies.

Permitted BAA1705 static time-kill records with matched MIC metadata. Review exposure/observation joins within source file and ID; retain censoring, missing dots and the reported control exposure without inventing replicate identities.

Permitted KP619 static time-kill records with a distinct matched MIC. Preserve file-scoped IDs, exposure rows and censored responses; static-design discrimination and target estimability remain downstream questions.

Permitted surveillance MIC distribution for coverage assessment and later weighted attainment. Retain 652-isolate denominator and reported percentages, including the unresolved 99.57 total; do not renormalize or replace matched strain MICs.

Permitted PMB-monotherapy static time-kill group summaries and MICs. Preserve duplicate-experiment means/SD and baseline definition; projected fCmax motivated tested concentrations but does not make them measured dynamic PK or authorize fitted results.

Permitted genotype, MIC and time-kill design metadata. Per-time CFU supplement is not retrieved, so metadata do not establish response coverage. Other-drug columns are context; published parameters remain outside primary review.
